resources.string: Shows the effect on top of every app. Nova uses an accessibility service only to know where you tap. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere: the app has no internet permission.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out on Android 13+: App info → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings.
Open “Installed apps” and switch on Nova

Touch effects on your home screen, with drag trails. Works on every Android version, no special access needed.
Touch the screen and watch stars and geometry come alive on a living grid.
Draws a touch effect where you tap. Nova does not read, store or send any screen content.
